content: codex-claude-bridge documents and recommends exactly two Codex models: `gpt-5.6-sol` as the default current flagship and `gpt-5.5` as the fallback. This recommendation boundary scopes defaults, README/model tables, error tips, and CLI/MCP help; explicitly configured other model IDs are still forwarded unchanged rather than blocked. Curate recommendations without gating user autonomy.
context: Policy originally captured after the 2026-04-23 model cleanup and recommend-not-enforce rollback. Updated 2026-07-09 after GPT-5.6 general availability: Codex's live model catalog identifies `gpt-5.6-sol` as the latest frontier agentic coding model, so the supported recommendation pair advanced from 5.5/5.4 to Sol/5.5. Keep this lesson, README, RECOMMENDED_MODELS, backend default, SDK pin, and help/error examples synchronized on future flagship releases.
title: Recommend gpt-5.6-sol + gpt-5.5 only; never block the user's model choice
